mentions.name: Review Box
mentions.description: A tool that helps with GitHub Pull Requests, featuring an integrated dashboard of what to review, symbol understanding, a clear split of reviewed/unreviewed files, and a result diff view that shows only how files will look after changes, reducing the need to open GitHub.
mentions.audience: Code reviewers and developers working with GitHub Pull Requests
mentions.source_excerpt: Over the last year, I've been working on Review Box https://review-box.rstankov.com/ on the side. It is a tool to help me with GitHub Pull Requests.
